sections.name: File setup, TimelineModule
sections.title: Feature wiring and global export
sections.what: Adds the controller and service to the app and marks the module global, so any feature can use the timeline service.
sections.why: Likely reason: avoids repeated imports in features that record timeline entries.
sections.watch_out: Because it is global, changes to the timeline service affect many features at once.

summary: Groups the timeline controller and service, and marks the timeline service as global so other features can use it without importing this module.
purpose: Makes timeline recording available across the app.
why: Likely reason: several features, such as reminders, write timeline entries, so a global module avoids repeated imports.
how: Lists the controller and service, exports the service, and marks the module global.
outputs: A module the main app loads.
risks: Global modules hide dependencies, so a missing one only shows up at startup. The timeline service needs the database and Redis, which are supplied elsewhere.
debug: If startup fails naming a missing provider, check the database and Redis modules are loaded.
